COLLECTION

Single collection from Steelbridge Fabrications, Birmingham B1 1AA, into the Birmingham consolidation centre. Delivery to EH1 1AA, Edinburgh.

TRUNK ITINERARY — FREIGHT BOARDS AND ALIGHTS AT THE CALLING POINT

|  PALLET LINE | PALLETS | WEIGHT / PALLET | JOINS TRUNK AT | LEAVES TRUNK AT  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|  Structural steel sections, banded | 4 | 420 kg | Birmingham (origin) | Edinburgh (destination)  |
|  Galvanised brackets, palletised | 2 | 380 kg | Birmingham (origin) | **Leaves at Leeds**  |
|  Welded frames, crated | 3 | 300 kg | **Joins at Leeds** | Edinburgh (destination)  |

Two pallets are dropped at Leeds and three are loaded there in their place. The Leeds → Edinburgh hop therefore carries 7 pallets, while Birmingham → Leeds carries 6 — the truck never carries all nine at once.

Total pallets booked: 9. Peak pallets on any one hop: 7 (Leeds → Edinburgh). Collection leg carries 6; delivery leg carries 7.

HANDLING NOTES

Quotation covers collection, the two-hop trunk via the Leeds calling point, and final delivery. One end-to-end line-haul rate applies to every pallet on the booking regardless of where it boards or alights; each calling point adds a flat handling fee. Pallet spaces vacated at Leeds are resold to freight boarding there.
